title: Housecarls
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. The housecarls: the player's housecarls, the Jarls and their housecarls, vanilla, DLC and CC. Each one owns its own level; no leveled list draws any of them.

families.holds: Lydia, Argis the Bulwark, Calder, Iona, Jordis the Sword-Maiden; the HearthFires housecarls Gregor, Rayya and Valdimar
the Jarls of the nine holds on both civil-war sides, and each Jarl's housecarl; Hrongar, Bryling and Erikur (in the Jarl faction, holding nothing)

sweep.title: Membership sweep (2026-10-02)
sweep.text: Every NPC in Skyrim, Update, Dawnguard, HearthFires, Dragonborn and the 74 CC packs that is in `PlayerHousecarlFaction` 0A2C8D, `BYOHHousecarlFaction` 008460:HearthFires.esm, `JobHousecarlFaction` 05091F or `JobJarlFaction` 050920, plus Bolgeir Bearclaw (Elisif's housecarl, in none of them); every record that takes a template from one of them; every placed reference. No CC pack adds a jarl or a housecarl, and no leveled list draws one.

filedElsewhere.what: Ulfric Stormcloak, Jarl of Eastmarch, and Galmar Stone-Fist, his housecarl
